question: Two engines of trains 60 km apart start towards each other at speeds of 16 km/hr and 29 km/hr, respectively. After how much time will they meet each other? (Assume the length of engine is negligible.)3622
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 60 km

Speed 1 = 16 km/hr

Speed 2 = 29 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (opposite direction) = Sum of speeds

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 16 + 29

⇒ Relative speed = 45 km/hr

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 45

⇒ Time = 4 ÷ 3 hours = 4/3 × 60 = 80 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 80 minutes.**
